messages.content: Let's pick up a networking rebuild.
IAM roles scoped per service? Taken care of. Let me know if anything looks off. Rewrote parts of .github/workflows/plan.yml as well.
Rewrote parts of terraform/iam.tf as well. Good news: a module for the standard service deployment made it in before the freeze.

There were no failures in the nightly run. Nobody has touched a drift detection job on a daily schedule yet. What broke the release was an S3 bucket name collision across accounts. What broke the release was a state lock left behind by a cancelled apply.
I'm leaning towards AWS as the single cloud provider.

Sounds right, on it. We can stop worrying about tagging enforced through a provider default now. The VPC with public and private subnets across three zones? Taken care of. Let me know if anything looks off.
CloudWatch alarms on the error rate metric went smoothly in the end. The root cause turned out to be subnet exhaustion in the primary availability zone.
We can stop worrying about security groups restricted to named ports now.
Terragrunt for the DRY module wiring sounds like the better deal to me.
S3 lifecycle rules moving logs to Glacier after 90 days is what we'll ship with. Agreed. Rewrote parts of terraform/variables.tf as well.
Once CI passes I'll merge. Good news: encrypted EBS volumes across all instances made it in before the freeze.
